content:
Context: - Section 80-D

Consequence of not linking PAN with Aadhaar.The PAN allotted to a person shall be deemed to be invalid, in case the person fails to intimate the Aadhaar number, on or before the notified date. If a person fails to intimate the Aadhaar number, the PAN allotted to such person shall be made inoperative in the prescribed manner. This amendment will take effect from 1st September, 2019.  
- Section 139-AA
